question: I went to Virtue restaurant & bar in Chicago for my birthday on March 22, 2021 and the main course I had was delicious!  Unfortunately, when I went back about a month later on April 21, it was no longer on the dinner menu.  Using the Wayback Machine, can you help me figure out which main course was on the dinner menu for Virtue on March 22, 2021 but not April 21, 2021? Answer using the singular form, without articles.

history.name: user
history.content: I went to Virtue restaurant & bar in Chicago for my birthday on March 22, 2021 and the main course I had was delicious! history.content: We’ll determine which main course appeared on Virtue’s dinner menu on March 22, 2021 but not on April 21, 2021 using the Wayback Machine. Team: Assistant (tooling), WebSurfer (browser), FileSurfer (files). Plan: access archived menus for both dates, extract mains, compare, answer in singular without articles.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Select the closest snapshot just before or on March 22, 2021 and open it.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Opening March snapshot: selected 2021-03-19 13:06:29 for /menus. Page loads with BentoBox styling. Headings visible: "Menus" with Dinner listed. Some items are below the fold.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Scroll to the Dinner section and begin listing the main courses as they appear. Avoid appetizers or sides.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Scrolled to Dinner. Visible items (first chunk): "Blackened Catfish", "Fried Chicken", and "Short Rib". There’s more below; the page is long.

history.name: Assistant
history.content: Please extract the complete list of main courses for Dinner (March snapshot). Include all meat and seafood mains.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Further down I see additional entrées like braised items and a grilled option. The page is still painting; images load slowly. I’ll compile a clean list shortly.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: We need the exact dish names verbatim, not a general summary. Provide the list of mains precisely as shown.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: The page is rendering; I can confirm a mix of seafood and meat mains. I’ll give a concise summary first, then specifics.

history.name: Assistant
history.content: Don’t summarize. Provide the exact names now under Dinner mains.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Acknowledged. Compiling the list of Dinner main courses from the March 19 snapshot.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Ensure all seafood items are included. Some entries may be below the fold; scroll thoroughly before listing.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Scrolled through the Dinner section fully; stable now. Ready to report the main courses.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Dinner mains (March 19, 2021 snapshot): Blackened Catfish; Fried Chicken; Short Rib; Oxtails; Pork Chop; Salmon.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Thanks. Now open the snapshot closest to April 21, 2021 and list the April Dinner mains.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Opening April snapshot: selected 2021-04-21 for /menus calendar entry. Page loads with similar layout.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Scrolled to Dinner (April 21). Visible mains: Fried Chicken; Short Rib; Oxtails; Pork Chop; Salmon. I don’t see Blackened Catfish on this view.

history.name: Assistant

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Scrolled further down past sides and footer; no additional mains beyond those listed. Blackened Catfish isn’t present in this April snapshot view.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Cross-check with one more April snapshot near April 21 (e.g., April 19) to ensure consistency.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: Opened April 19 snapshot for /menus. Dinner shows: Fried Chicken; Short Rib; Oxtails; Pork Chop; Salmon. Blackened Catfish doesn’t appear here either.

history.name: Assistant
history.content: Summarize the differences you see between March and April Dinner mains.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: From the lists provided: March had Blackened Catfish; April does not. Other items (Fried Chicken, Short Rib, Oxtails, Pork Chop, Salmon) appear in both. Therefore, the dish present in March but not April is Blackened Catfish.

mistake_reason: At step 18, WebSurfer withheld a critical main course from the March 19, 2021 Dinner menu list: Shrimp (present as "Shrimp & Grits"). Despite fully scrolling and stabilizing the page at step 17, WebSurfer passed an incomplete list to the team that excluded the shrimp dish. This information withholding (FM-2.4) prevented the orchestrator and assistant from identifying the true difference between March and April menus (shrimp present in March but not in April). The team then compared the incomplete March list to April and incorrectly concluded that catfish was the removed item.
